mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MENU_AUTH ( COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE, AUTH_YN, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{userId}, #{menuCode}, #{actionCode}, #{authYn}, 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT #{companyCode} AS companyCode, #{userId} AS userId, X.MENU_CODE AS menuCode, X.ACTION_CODE AS actionCode, X.AUTH_YN AS authYn FROM ( SELECT M.MENU_CODE AS MENU_CODE, AM.ACTION_CODE AS ACTION_CODE, NVL(UA.AUTH_YN, RA.AUTH_YN) AS AUTH_YN FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M JOIN TB_MENU_ACTION_MASTER AM ON M.COMPANY_CODE = AM.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = AM.MENU_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE, MAX(AUTH_YN) AS AUTH_YN FROM TB_ROLE_MENU_AUTH WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND ROLE_CODE IN ( SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM TB_USER_ROLE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND USER_ID = #{userId} ) GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE ) RA ON M.COMPANY_CODE = RA.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = RA.MENU_CODE AND AM.ACTION_CODE = RA.ACTION_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER_MENU_AUTH UA ON M.COMPANY_CODE = UA.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = UA.MENU_CODE AND AM.ACTION_CODE = UA.ACTION_CODE AND UA.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ) X WHERE X.AUTH_YN = 'Y'
